auto.actor_hint: In automations, "the person running it" is the user the automation runs as.
auto.all_hint: Every automation of every form, with how its last run ended. Open one to change it or to see its runs.
auto.attach_to_hint: The generated document is added to this file field of the record.
auto.backoff_hint: The first wait comes before the second attempt; the last one repeats for any further attempts.
auto.condition_hint: Only records that meet it are acted on; leave it empty for every record.
auto.confirm_above_hint: Runs over more records wait for someone to confirm. Empty: never.
auto.conflict: Someone else changed this automation. Their version is now shown; make your changes again.
auto.cron_hint: Five parts: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.
auto.day_hint: 1 to 28, so every month has it.
auto.delete_confirm: Delete the automation "{name}" and its run history?
auto.deliver_to_hint: Users and roles; someone without access to the profile is skipped.
auto.download_hint: A shared profile of this form; each recipient gets their own file, with what they may see, by e-mail.
auto.empty_text: Add one to update records, send messages or call other systems without anyone clicking.
auto.enabled_desc: When off, nothing starts it and its schedules stop; you can still test it.
auto.folder_hint: A folder inside the watched-folders location set up on the server, e.g. invoices/incoming.
auto.hint: Automations act on their own when something happens to a record, on a schedule, when a date arrives or when a file is dropped in a folder. Each one runs as a user and can only do what that user may do.
auto.history_hint: Each run with what started it, the records it covered and changed, and each step's outcome.
auto.inbound_endpoint_hint: Set these up under Integrations › Incoming.
auto.key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; used in exports between environments.
auto.limits_hint: How much one run may do, and when it waits for someone to confirm.
auto.load_failed: The automations could not be loaded.
auto.max_chain_depth_hint: How many automations deep a chain may go before it is stopped.
auto.max_records_hint: A run that would cover more does not start.
auto.name: Name
auto.name_field_hint: Optional; useful when the form requires a title.
auto.no_inbound_endpoints: This form has no incoming webhooks
auto.no_steps_text: An automation does nothing until it has steps. Choose what the first step does below and add it.
auto.on_failure_hint.continue: The failure is noted and the next step runs.
auto.on_failure_hint.retry: Tried again on the retry settings below, then stops.
auto.publish_first: Publish the form before creating automations.
auto.retry_hint: A failed run is tried again, waiting a little longer each time.
auto.run_as_user_hint: Schedules, dates and folders need one. Only those who manage permissions can choose someone other than themselves.
auto.run_failed: The automation could not be started.
auto.run_hint: Every step obeys the permissions, record rules and field access of the user it runs as.
auto.run_now_confirm: Run the automation now for every record that meets its condition?
auto.save_before_test: Save your changes to test or run the automation.
auto.save_failed: The automation could not be saved.
auto.started_status.awaiting_confirmatio: The run covers many records and waits for confirmation in the run history.
auto.started_status.skipped_loop: The run was stopped by loop protection.
auto.steps_hint: Run in order for each record; each step sees the changes of the ones before it.
auto.steps_hint_sets: Run in order for each record the run covers. Waiting is only possible when every trigger runs for one record.
auto.subtitle: What starts it, which records it acts on, what it does, and how it runs.
auto.test_hint: Runs every step against the record you choose and then undoes the changes. E-mails, notifications, webhooks, documents and downloads are not sent; the result says what they would do.
auto.trigger.watched_folder: A file arrives in a folder
auto.trigger_hint.condition_true: Runs when a save makes the condition below true; it does not run again while it stays true.
auto.trigger_hint.date_reached: Runs for each record when its date, moved by the offset, arrives — once per date.
auto.trigger_hint.field_changed: Runs when this field gets a new value.
auto.trigger_hint.inbound_webhook: Runs for the record an incoming webhook of this form created or updated.
auto.trigger_hint.manual: Lets people who may run automations start it from here, for every record that meets the condition.
auto.trigger_hint.record_created: Runs for each new record, as the person who created it or the chosen user.
auto.trigger_hint.record_deleted: Runs when a record goes to the recycle bin; it can only send messages and call webhooks.
auto.trigger_hint.record_updated: Runs each time a record is saved with a change.
auto.trigger_hint.schedule: Runs once on each scheduled time, for every record that meets the condition.
auto.trigger_hint.status_changed: Runs when a record moves between these statuses (leave one empty for any).
auto.trigger_hint.watched_folder: Each file placed in this folder becomes a record of this form, then the automation runs for it.
auto.triggers_hint: Any one of these starts the automation.
auto.unpublished_title: The form is not published yet
auto.wait_hint: The run continues with the next step after this many minutes.
sched.hint: Everything scheduled across the system: automation schedules, scheduled downloads and the system's own jobs, with when each runs next and how it last ended.
sched.name: Task
sched.system.schema_reconcile_scheduled: Check the database matches the forms
